decisions.reason: Caption color and text effects are independent of the font choice, and their same-message changes are already represented.
Using the specified caption font does not change the separate clean-editing and prohibited-effects rules.
The font correction does not alter narrative completeness or standalone-understandability requirements; their same-message changes are already represented.
The specified caption font has no necessary effect on permitted source material or batch source selection.
The instruction to redo all eight clips is separately represented by an existing same-message MODIFY and is not a necessary state consequence of the font change.
Caption font selection does not change the requirement to choose moments that teach something, and message 119 does not establish a new value beyond the existing standard.
The font correction does not change the independent hook-selection criterion.
The font decision does not alter the existing 20-to-120-second duration bounds.
The caption font standard does not change the monthly target or approved-clip counting basis.
